question: HAL-developed ‘Prachand’ is which type of aircraft?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Light Combat Helicopter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Prachand'** is an advanced **Light Combat Helicopter (LCH)** developed by **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)**, a leading aerospace and defense company in India.
 
• This helicopter was officially inducted into the **Indian Air Force (IAF)** and the **Indian Army** in **October 2022**, strengthening India’s combat capabilities.
 
• The LCH is designed to meet the unique requirements of high-altitude warfare, making it highly effective in regions like the **Himalayas**.
 
• **Prachand** is equipped with state-of-the-art avionics, advanced weapons systems, and stealth features, enabling it to operate in hostile environments.
 
• The helicopter is capable of performing multiple roles, including **anti-tank operations, search and rescue missions, close air support, and counter-insurgency** operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Development and Features:**

 
 
• The **Light Combat Helicopter (LCH)** project was initiated by HAL to fulfill the need for an indigenous combat helicopter capable of operating at high altitudes.
 
• It is powered by **two Shakti engines**, jointly developed by HAL and **Safran Helicopter Engines of France**, ensuring high performance in extreme conditions.
 
• Its advanced features include **stealth technology, crash-resistant landing gear, and armor protection**.
 
 
 
• **Operational Use:**
 
 
• The LCH can operate in diverse terrains, including **desert, jungle, and mountainous regions**, making it versatile in warfare scenarios.
 
• It is equipped with **air-to-ground missiles, anti-tank missiles, rocket pods, and a 20-mm turret gun** for precision strikes.
 
• It also incorporates advanced sensors and electronic warfare capabilities for enhanced situational awareness.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• The induction of **'Prachand'** into the Indian Armed Forces strengthens India’s defense capabilities against threats from neighboring countries like **China and Pakistan**.
 
• Its ability to operate at altitudes of up to **16,000 feet** makes it indispensable in protecting India’s border regions, especially in the **Ladakh sector**.
 
• It has been designed to counter armored threats and provide support in high-altitude conflicts.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• The LCH is comparable to other globally recognized combat helicopters, such as the **AH-64 Apache** (USA) and the **Eurocopter Tiger** (Europe).
 
• Its indigenous production reduces dependency on foreign imports, aligning with the Indian government’s **‘Make in India’** initiative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Competitors:**

 
 
• **AH-64 Apache:** Used by the United States, equipped with advanced radar and weapon systems.
 
• **Eurocopter Tiger:** Developed by Europe, known for its agility and precision targeting.
 
• **Mi-24 Hind:** Russian combat helicopter with heavy firepower and troop-carrying capability.
 
 
 
• **HAL’s Contribution:**
 
 
• HAL has been instrumental in developing indigenous aircraft such as the **Tejas Light Combat Aircraft** and the **Dhruv Advanced Light Helicopter**.
 
• It plays a critical role in enhancing India’s defense ecosystem by manufacturing high-quality, cost-effective aviation solutions.
 
 
 
• **Technological Advancements:**
 
 
• The **Prachand** incorporates modern avionics, including **helmet-mounted displays, infrared targeting systems, and night vision capabilities**.
 
• Its stealth features minimize radar detection, providing a tactical advantage in combat scenarios.
